title: Let Run Once perform its own queue scan
summary: Normal Run Once no longer depends on a separately completed or idle Queue preview scan.
reason: The pipeline engine performs authoritative queue discovery during a normal run, so blocking launch on preview-scan lifecycle duplicated that work and produced an unnecessary operator error.
behavior_before: Run Once preflight and submission were blocked while a Queue preview scan was active or when its snapshot was missing, stale, empty, or mismatched.
behavior_after: Run Once reports normal queue scope ready and lets the pipeline engine scan configured source roots at startup; Queue preview state remains advisory.
tests_added: Updated test_run_once_preflight_does_not_require_or_wait_for_queue_scan to cover running, stale, empty, mismatched, and incomplete preview evidence.
rollback_plan: Restore the queue-preview snapshot gate in _normal_queue_scope_preflight_check and its prior regression expectations.
notes:
Cover Run Once preflight across running and stale queue preview states.
Make separate queue preview scan advisory for normal Run Once.
Refresh source summary after preflight change.
Refresh test summary after regression update.
